decisions.label: clear
decisions.evidence: When you visit our sites, our computers may automatically collect statistics about your visit. This information does not identify you personally, but rather about your visit to our sites. We may monitor statistics such as how many people visit our sites, the user's IP address, which pages people visit on our sites, from which domains our visitors reach our sites, and which browsers people use.
decisions.rationale: The policy discloses collecting IP addresses and device information through automatic collection of statistics.
